targets.query:
from(bucket: "label_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "TRIPLE_BARRIER_LABEL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.exchange_name == "${exchange}" and r.symbol == "${symbol}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.param_id == "${param_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "label")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

winCount = from(bucket: "label_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "TRIPLE_BARRIER_LABEL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.exchange_name == "${exchange}" and r.symbol == "${symbol}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.param_id == "${param_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "label" and r._value == 1)
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Win" }))

lossCount = from(bucket: "label_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "TRIPLE_BARRIER_LABEL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.exchange_name == "${exchange}" and r.symbol == "${symbol}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.param_id == "${param_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "label" and r._value == -1)
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Loss" }))

timeoutCount = from(bucket: "label_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "TRIPLE_BARRIER_LABEL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.exchange_name == "${exchange}" and r.symbol == "${symbol}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.param_id == "${param_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "label" and r._value == 0)
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Timeout" }))

union(tables: [winCount, lossCount, timeoutCount])

from(bucket: "label_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "TRIPLE_BARRIER_LABEL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.exchange_name == "${exchange}" and r.symbol == "${symbol}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.param_id == "${param_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "label" and r._value == 1)

winCount = from(bucket: "label_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "TRIPLE_BARRIER_LABEL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.exchange_name == "${exchange}" and r.symbol == "${symbol}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.param_id == "${param_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "label" and r._value == 1)
  |> count()
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")

lossCount = from(bucket: "label_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "TRIPLE_BARRIER_LABEL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.exchange_name == "${exchange}" and r.symbol == "${symbol}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.param_id == "${param_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "label" and r._value == -1)
  |> count()
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")

win = if length(arr: winCount) > 0 then winCount[0] else 0
loss = if length(arr: lossCount) > 0 then lossCount[0] else 0
winRate = if (win + loss) > 0 then float(v: win) / float(v: win + loss) else 0.0

array.from(rows: [{_value: winRate}])

timeoutCount = from(bucket: "label_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "TRIPLE_BARRIER_LABEL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.exchange_name == "${exchange}" and r.symbol == "${symbol}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.param_id == "${param_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "label" and r._value == 0)
  |> count()
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")

totalCount = from(bucket: "label_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "TRIPLE_BARRIER_LABEL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.exchange_name == "${exchange}" and r.symbol == "${symbol}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.param_id == "${param_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "label")
  |> count()
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")

timeout = if length(arr: timeoutCount) > 0 then timeoutCount[0] else 0
total = if length(arr: totalCount) > 0 then totalCount[0] else 0
timeoutRate = if total > 0 then float(v: timeout) / float(v: total) else 0.0

array.from(rows: [{_value: timeoutRate}])
